results.source_text:
to main:
    let count_answer be ask for a number ""
    if count_answer is nothing:
        stop
    let count be value of count_answer
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let stack be 0
        let good be yes
        for each bracket in line split by "":
            if bracket is "(":
                set stack to stack * 4 + 1
            otherwise if bracket is "[":
                set stack to stack * 4 + 2
            otherwise if bracket is "{{":
                set stack to stack * 4 + 3
            otherwise:
                if stack is 0:
                    set good to no
                otherwise:
                    let rest be floor of (stack divided by 4)
                    let top be stack - rest * 4
                    if bracket is ")" and top is not 1:
                        set good to no
                    if bracket is "]" and top is not 2:
                        set good to no
                    if bracket is "}}" and top is not 3:
                        set good to no
                    set stack to rest
        if stack is not 0:
            set good to no
        if good:
            say "valid"
        otherwise:
            say "invalid"

        otherwise:

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say ""
        stop
    let count be value of count_input
    let output be ""
    let first_output be yes
    let index be 0
    let run_start be 0
    let run_end be 0
    while index is less than count:
        let number_input be ask for a number ""
        if number_input is nothing:
            stop
        let current_value be value of number_input
        if index is 0:
            set run_start to current_value
            set run_end to current_value
        otherwise if current_value is run_end + 1:
            set run_end to current_value
        otherwise:
            let run_length be run_end - run_start + 1
            let piece be ""
            if run_length is at least 3:
                set piece to "{run_start}-{run_end}"
            otherwise if run_length is 2:
                set piece to "{run_start},{run_end}"
            otherwise:
                set piece to "{run_start}"
            if first_output:
                set output to piece
                set first_output to no
            otherwise:
                set output to output + "," + piece
            set run_start to current_value
            set run_end to current_value
        set index to index + 1
    if count is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let run_length be run_end - run_start + 1
        let piece be ""
        if run_length is at least 3:
            set piece to "{run_start}-{run_end}"
        otherwise if run_length is 2:
            set piece to "{run_start},{run_end}"
        otherwise:
            set piece to "{run_start}"
        if first_output:
            set output to piece
        otherwise:
            set output to output + "," + piece
        say output

to main:
    let count_maybe be ask for a number ""
    if count_maybe is nothing:
        stop
    let n be value of count_maybe
    let names be "__sentinel__" split by " "
    let amounts be "0" split by " "
    let distinct be 0
    repeat n times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        let product be item 1 of parts
        let change_text be item 2 of parts
        let change be change_text as number
        let found be no
        let cursor be 1
        for each existing in names:
            if existing is product:
                let current be item cursor of amounts as number
                let updated be current + change
                set item cursor of amounts to "{updated}"
                set found to yes
            set cursor to cursor + 1
        if found is no:
            add product to names
            add "{change}" to amounts
            set distinct to distinct + 1
    repeat distinct times:
        let best be ""
        let best_cursor be 0
        let cursor be 1
        for each existing in names:
            if existing is not "__sentinel__":
                if best_cursor is 0:
                    set best to existing
                    set best_cursor to cursor
                otherwise:
                    if existing is less than best:
                        set best to existing
                        set best_cursor to cursor
            set cursor to cursor + 1
        say best + " " + item best_cursor of amounts
        set item best_cursor of names to "__sentinel__"

to main:
    let count_maybe be ask for a number ""
    if count_maybe is nothing:
        stop
    let count be value of count_maybe
    let all_lines be ""
    let all_names be ""
    repeat count times:
        let line be ask ""
        let parts be line split by " "
        let name be item 1 of parts
        if all_lines is "":
            set all_lines to line
            set all_names to name
        otherwise:
            set all_lines to all_lines + "|" + line
            set all_names to all_names + " " + name
    if count is not 0:
        let lines be all_lines split by "|"
        let names be all_names split by " "
        let previous be ""
        for each name in sorted names:
            if name is not previous:
                let total be 0
                for each line in lines:
                    let parts be line split by " "
                    if item 1 of parts is name:
                        let change be item 2 of parts as number
                        set total to total + change
                say name + " " + total as text
                set previous to name
